frames.name: rts-ai-attack.playtest.json
frames.regions: Coordinates are native 1280x720, read by eye from the raw frames. I had no crop or measuring tool. HUD: the six frames share one geometry and only the fills change, from BEFORE teal translucent to PINNED/AUTO near-black. Elements: resources x16..324,y16..64; strike-group panel x16..304,y565..704; tactical overview x1088..1264,y303..~497 (its lower part is hidden behind the buttons in every arm, unchanged); 16 command/build buttons plus PAUSE x971..1264,y481..626 and x1201..1264,y680..704; hint x944..1264,y634..664 (a black box that is absent in BEFORE). Infantry cluster x795..900,y312..398: five light-green bars at about y317/331/338/349/360 (about x798..896) and ring arcs along its lower and right edge (about x803..890,y360..396). Ring and overhead cues: command-core ring about x515..650,y345..442 (bar about y343); war-foundry ring about x682..782,y440..487 (bar about y408); extractor ring about x298..378,y395..442 (overhead line about y381); turret ring about x597..663,y255..288 (bar about y235); tank (about x713..768) and blue vehicle (about x815..872) overhead lines about y272/273 plus small base rings. Resources and small units: crystals about x425..545,y218..322; harvesters about x462..540,y268..328 and about x395..432,y357..398. Scene: sand and grid floor, grey outer ring, top-left dark void, teal pool at the bottom edge about x935..1065,y703..720.
frames.reason:
Alignment: the camera, the crystal, harvester, building and vehicle positions, the overhead-bar rows and the ring footprints coincide across BEFORE 1-2, PINNED 1-2 and AUTO 1-2. The HUD state is identical in all six frames (ORE 1,380, GAS 278, SUPPLY 23/30, CLOCK 00:42, '10 SELECTED Vanguard, Assault infantry, 100/100, -54 · 47, IDLE'). I see no action, timing or state mismatch, so the BEFORE-to-PINNED differences are rendering and HUD changes, not gameplay differences. The two repeats within each arm are indistinguishable by eye.

HUD (improved, nothing lost): every label, resource figure, status line, progress bar, the 16 buttons, PAUSE and the minimap content (frustum outline about x1097..1221,y355, marker about x1103,y353, teal blob about x1103..1153,y420..475) is present at the same position. The black backings give clearly higher contrast than BEFORE's teal panels, most visibly on the small caps labels (ORE/GAS/SUPPLY/CLOCK, STRIKE GROUP, TACTICAL OVERVIEW) and on the hint line. The minimap interior is now navy on black instead of navy on teal, so it is less distinct from its frame. Its thin outline, frustum rectangle, marker and blob are still clearly visible, so I count no cue as lost. Deviation from the stated intent: the hint (x944..1264,y634..664) now sits on a black box that BEFORE did not have, so original transparency was not preserved for that element. It improves legibility, so I do not treat it as a regression, but it is an unrequested visible change for the whole-kit review. The hint text also runs flush to the box's right edge.

Rings and bars: the command-core, war-foundry, extractor and turret rings are bold cyan with a dark rim in PINNED, against thin pale teal in BEFORE. The small base rings under the tank and blue vehicle are easier to see. The overhead bars and lines keep their positions with the same or better visibility. None is missing, blurred or doubled.

Infantry cluster x795..900,y312..398, both PINNED repeats against both BEFORE repeats: the same overlapping bodies, the same five light-green bars at about y317/331/338/349/360, and the same ring arcs along the lower edge. I see no blur, ghosting or doubling, and the bars and rings are at least as visible. The bodies read lighter in absolute value because the whole scene tone rose, so the floor behind them is lighter too. They keep dark outlines and joint facets. I could not confirm any local-contrast loss, missing ring or bar, or soft edge. The pale or soft look from the earlier automatic observation is absent from both PINNED repeats and both fresh AUTO repeats.

Scene: form shading is stronger on the command core, the foundry (teal roof panel with light edges) and the extractor (lime top). Contact shadows and grounding under the buildings, vehicles, harvesters and infantry persist, with no floating. The crystals, grid, sand-to-grey edge, top-left void, lime top and bottom-edge pool are preserved. I saw no banding, grain, clipped patch, broad dirty halo or missing object. I do not credit the brightness rise itself.

AUTO is indistinguishable from PINNED by eye, which fits both being reported as scale1/1280x720/samples4. The gain over BEFORE therefore cannot be credited to pinning.

reason:
This is a single-pose safety preflight, not whole-kit acceptance. Original BEFORE and fresh PINNED AFTER show the same camera and the same HUD state. PINNED reads better in the HUD (black backings, with a new box behind the hint), ring and bar cue strength (dark-rimmed rings) and building form shading. I found no confirmed fainter or missing cue, no lost contact or floating, and no artifact or missing object. Both PINNED repeats were checked against both BEFORE repeats. The infantry cluster at x795..900,y312..398 keeps its bars and rings and shows no confirmed loss. The pose therefore passes safety as IMPROVEMENT, which is a low-risk label because its gains are in cue contrast and shading and not in brightness. Fresh AUTO matches PINNED by eye, so the gain over BEFORE comes from the candidate's HUD, underlay and tone changes and not from the pin. The hint box deviates from the stated 'preserve original transparency' claim, but it only improves legibility.

L9 boards (used directionally only; the RTS pose has no sky, specular, sphere or room content, so nothing is inferred about those):
- harness-L9-source.png: panels 1-3 are ThreeNative C++ (Wasm/WebGPU). Panel 1 is aa2f1311e (before tonemap); panels 2 and 3 are f97578097 (tonemap merged, runs 1 and 2). Panel 4, far right, is Unreal 5.8.3 L9 sun60 spheres. The two merged runs repeat each other. All four share the wall, dark-box and cream sun-highlight layout and a similar neutral grey wall. ThreeNative's sky reflection is a deeper blue with crisper cloud blobs than Unreal's paler, softer clouds. These are low-resolution crops, so the comparison is only directional.
- harness-L9-full-sun60.png: columns 1-2 are ThreeNative (labelled 'WASM ENGINE last post (now1)' and 'WASM ENGINE now'). Column 3 is Unreal 5.8.3. The ThreeNative 'now' column keeps crisp dark contact shadows and neutral light-grey grounds comparable to Unreal's. Not every row moves toward Unreal: the 'now' interior floor is greyer than Unreal's bluish floor, and its sky and clouds are stylised. The RTS PINNED frames' firmer contact shadows and stronger facet separation point the same general direction, but that is not parity evidence and I do not demand palette or geometry matching.
limitations:
Method: I could only use Read. There was no crop, zoom, pixel diff or luminance measurement, so every coordinate and contrast judgement is by eye at native 1280x720. The six-frame sheet is downsampled (2560x2352 shown at 2000x1838) and was used only for side-by-side comparison.

Residual risk I could not measure: the lightest infantry and tank surfaces now sit closer in value to a brighter floor. I saw no confirmed loss, because the dark facets, outlines, bars and rings keep the silhouette, but I could not exclude a small local-contrast reduction on those light faces. A cropped luminance and contrast measurement of x795..900,y312..398 is advisable before whole-kit sign-off.

Cause and scale: per the disclosure, AUTO and PINNED were both scale1/1280x720/samples4, and the earlier automatic 0.85 observation was not reproduced. No visual or performance improvement caused by pinning is established. BEFORE's scale window was not available to me, so I do not attribute any sharpness difference between BEFORE and PINNED to resolution.

Not verifiable from stills: exposure settling, pumping or flicker, adaptation, temporal stability (including shimmer on thin grid lines and rings in motion), audio, the sustained display.maxFps60 budget, and whether every effect is retained. I can only say no effect is visibly missing. Matching repeats show endpoint repeatability only.

Visibility limits: every frame is at clock 00:42 with the 10 selected infantry IDLE. There are no hostile units, no move or attack order markers, and no combat, projectile or damage feedback visible, and I can't see off-screen content. Enemy-colour readability, active-order ring cues and combat cues are therefore unassessed. The only non-teal accent visible is the lime extractor top, which is preserved.

The L9 boards are low-resolution crops. The 'now' spheres cylinder shows faint vertical streaking, which I note but do not treat as RTS evidence.

This covers a single pose, so whole-kit IMPROVEMENT is still required later.
